items.name: Eyvind's Cut Arm-Ring
items.lore: Silver, cut through where an oath was broken. It can never be mended.

items.name: Oathbreaker's Cloak
items.lore: Ragged and black. Deserters of the blood-fellowship wear them so they can find each other.

items.name: Huginfel Hearth-Ring
items.lore: The kind of ring a mother gives a son who came home.

items.name: Blood-Fellowship Torc
items.lore: Taken from a svard of the blodfelag. The inside is stained.

items.name: Haxa's Binding-Cord
items.lore: Plaited from wolf hair and a woman's. Cut now. It still twitches sometimes.

items.name: Wolf-Brother Pelt
items.lore: A sveawolf's grey pelt, freely given.

items.name: Shield-Mate's Ring
items.lore: Huscarls who stand together trade rings. Grettir gave you his.

items.name: Gothi Rune-Belt
items.lore: Carved with the runes for 'man' and 'return'.

items.name: Thrall-Chain Bracer
items.lore: A broken shackle, padded and worn on the arm.

items.name: Huginfel Gate Ring
items.lore: Iron, stamped with Huginfel's gate.

items.name: Oath-Cut Belt
items.lore: A belt cut from an oathbreaker's own. He won't need it.

items.name: Shieldwall Shoulder-Cloak
items.lore: Huginfel red, with the shieldwall's boss.

items.name: Blood-Oath Scroll Charm
items.lore: A strip of the oath-scroll, the blood gone brown.

items.name: Henchman-Breaker's Ring
items.lore: Heavy iron. Sigvaldi's gift.

items.name: Wind-Sprite Feather
items.lore: It drifts upward if you let it go.

items.name: Gothi's Ward-Cord
items.lore: Nine knots, nine runes.

items.name: She-Wolf Fang Torc
items.lore: A she-wolf's fangs on a twist of iron.

items.name: Woodland Stalker's Bracer
items.lore: Soft leather, for silent walking.

items.name: Wood-Wife's Leaf Ring
items.lore: A ring of living leaf. It stays green.

items.name: Skogsfru Bark Mantle
items.lore: Birch-bark, soft as cloth.

items.name: Never-Thaw Ice Charm
items.lore: A chip of the gully's ice in a silver cage. It hasn't melted.

items.name: Wolf-Widow's Shawl
items.lore: Ragnfrid's own, grey and heavy.

items.name: Cold-Light Lantern Charm
items.lore: A tiny lantern. It glows blue and gives no heat.

items.name: Frost-Ward Bracer
items.lore: Fur-lined iron.

items.name: Frost-Colt Mane Torc
items.lore: Braided white hair that crackles like frost.

items.name: Snow-Imp's Cap Charm
items.lore: A little white cap. It's always cold inside.

items.name: Gully-Walker's Mantle
items.lore: Fur and wool, for walking on ice that isn't ice.

items.name: Warhound-Collar Torc
items.lore: Spiked, and too heavy for anything but a Blodfelag hound.

items.name: Wolf-Widow's Ring
items.lore: Ragnfrid's husband's ring. She wants you to have it.

items.name: Windcaller's Bone Whistle
items.lore: Blow it and the air goes cold. Don't.

items.name: Snow-Ward Belt
items.lore: Thick wool, rune-stitched against the cold.

items.name: Wolfwarrior's Pelt-Mantle
items.lore: A whole wolf-pelt, jaws for a hood.

items.name: Berserk-Breaker's Ring
items.lore: Grettir's gift: plain iron, very heavy.

items.name: Blood-Hall Spear Torc
items.lore: Iron, with a broken spear-head hung from it.

items.name: Frozen Blood-Bowl Charm
items.lore: A shard of the haxa's bowl, the blood in it still frozen.

items.name: Haxa-Bane Bracer
items.lore: Rowan wood and iron.

items.name: Vindsaul Huscarl Mantle
items.lore: The King's blue, from the frontier keep.

items.name: Shieldwall Oath-Ring
items.lore: The Shieldwall's oath ring: an oath you keep.

items.name: Blood-Hall Scout's Belt
items.lore: Dark leather, for creeping close.

items.name: Svartalf Hunter's Ring
items.lore: Dark iron, dwarf-work gone wrong.

items.name: Southern Road Cloak
items.lore: Dust-brown, for long roads.

items.name: Chanter's Scale-Pin
items.lore: A red scale pinned like a brooch.

items.name: Drakulv-Pass Belt
items.lore: The pass's leather case, made into a belt.
